raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Adds the B200 AgentX lane of [SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX#4554](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4554) (keys `dsv4-fp4-b200-vllm-agentic-mtp` and `dsv4-fp4-b200-vllm-agentic-mtp-lowconc`) to `recipes/models/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Pro.yaml` as two opt-in tuned presets, following #63534. The recipe had no B200 AgentX coverage.

## Claims

- Two presets for the 0813 checkpoint with DSpark (six draft tokens), 13 points, each with its pinned image:

  | Preset | Strategy | Points |
  |---|---|---|
  | `b200_agentx_tp` | `single_node_tp`, TP8 | c1, c4 (low latency), c6, c10, c14 |
  | `b200_agentx_dep` | `single_node_dep` | DEP8 c64, c96, c128, c160, c192; TP4 x DP2 c32; TP2 x DP4 c48, c64 |

- Per-point `--max-num-seqs`, `--max-num-batched-tokens`, `--kv-cache-memory-bytes` and CUDA graph capture sizes are rendered as flags. The DP points add the Simple CPU KV tier (241.5 GB per rank) and the router tab's consistent-hash vLLM Router; the router's `--request-timeout-secs` and `--disable-retries` are in the runbook.
- Presets are opt-in; no existing rendering changes.
- Left out on purpose: `VLLM_PREFIX_CACHE_RETENTION_INTERVAL` (removed in v0.30.0, #55353; only c10 sets the flag, as the lane did), `--served-model-name`, and the benchmark's synthetic acceptance length.
- The TP presets keep `--no-enable-flashinfer-autotune` instead of the builder's `--disable-flashinfer-autotune`, which the pinned image does not define.

## Not a duplicate

No open PR touches this file's presets or adds B200 AgentX coverage.

## Validation

- `node scripts/validate-source.mjs --source vllm --dir <this checkout>/recipes` and `npm run test:presets` (14 pass) pass against vllm-project/recipes main.
- Rendered all 13 points (`/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Pro/presets/<key>.json`) and compared each against the effective lane config at #4554 head `2c044c3`: flags, values, environment and image match, 0 mismatches.
- Not compared against server logs of a completed run. InferenceX #4554 sweep and evals are green at that head, but the PR is not merged yet.

AI assistance was used: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (`claude-sonnet-5-5`) prepared the change and a human reviewed it.

@@ -275,6 +275,343 @@ strategy_overrides:
         - "--enable-sleep-mode"
       env: {}
 
+# Tuned presets (InferenceX AgentX lanes); see SCHEMA.md "presets".
+presets:
+  b200_agentx_tp:
+    label: "AgentX TP8"
+    hardware: b200
+    strategy: single_node_tp
+    tp: 8
+    variants: [default]
+    workload: "Agentic (InferenceX AgentX)"
+    description: "TP8 on one 8-GPU B200 node with DSpark (six draft tokens), FlashInfer sparse MLA and a fixed 50 GiB KV cache per GPU; no host KV offload."
+    source: { label: "InferenceX #4554", href: "https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4554", key: "dsv4-fp4-b200-vllm-agentic-mtp", revision: 2c044c3 }
+    image: "vllm/vllm-openai:nightly-8e2beaa3bff595577a069d49d96bde9074294ec2@sha256:3207cb99c0f59b92f7d47a74da8c6eb5467565d811a4f8d9df51df5188f59c70"
+    select:
+      features: { spec_decoding: dspark }
+    # The lane's FlashInfer sparse MLA attention config replaces the builder's
+    # standalone MXFP4 indexer flag; DSpark drafts six tokens, not seven; the pinned
+    # image predates --disable-flashinfer-autotune, so keep the --no-enable form.
+    remove_args: ["--attention_config.indexer_kv_dtype=mxfp4", "--disable-flashinfer-autotune"]
+    args:
+      - "--no-enable-flashinfer-autotune"
+      - "--max-model-len"
+      - "1048576"
+      - "--gpu-memory-utilization"
+      - "0.90"
+      - "--max-num-batched-tokens"
+      - "16384"
+      - "--numa-bind"
+      - "--enable-cumem-allocator"
+      - "--disable-uvicorn-access-log"
+      - "--no-disable-hybrid-kv-cache-manager"
+      - "--attention-config"
+      - '{"backend":"FLASHINFER_MLA_SPARSE_DSV4","use_prefill_query_quantization":true,"indexer_kv_dtype":"mxfp4"}'
+    json_args:
+      "--speculative-config": { num_speculative_tokens: 6 }
+    env:
+      VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER: "1"
+      VLLM_FLOAT32_MATMUL_PRECISION: "high"
+      TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST: "10.0"
+      VLLM_ENGINE_READY_TIMEOUT_S: "7200"
+      VLLM_RPC_TIMEOUT: "600000"
+    # --max-num-seqs equals the concurrency. Graphs capture every decode batch of up to
+    # that many sequences (target plus six drafts each) and mixed batches of 100-500 tokens.
+    points:
+      c1:
+        label: "1"
+        concurrency: 1
+        args:
+          - "--max-num-seqs"
+          - "1"
+          - "--kv-cache-memory-bytes"
+          - "53687091200"
+          - "--compilation-config"
+          - '{"cudagraph_mode":"FULL_AND_PIECEWISE","cudagraph_capture_sizes":[7,100,200,300,400,500]}'
+        env:
+          VLLM_DSV4_MEGA_FP8_COMBINE: "1"
+      c4:
+        label: "4 (low latency)"
+        concurrency: 4
+        image: "vllm/vllm-openai@sha256:d428631bb917a33d22308265d1b8be91522f862bf9fd133bee62dde3313664ae"
+        args:
+          - "--max-num-seqs"
+          - "4"
+          - "--kv-cache-memory-bytes"
+          - "42949672960"
+          - "--compilation-config"
+          - '{"cudagraph_mode":"FULL_AND_PIECEWISE","cudagraph_capture_sizes":[7,14,21,28,100,200,300,400,500,640,800,1024,1280,1600,2048,2560,3200,4096,5120,6400,8192,10240,12800,16384],"max_cudagraph_capture_size":16384}'
+          - "--sparse-indexer-topk-backend"
+          - "deep_select"
+        env:
+          VLLM_DSV4_MEGA_FP8_COMBINE: "1"
+      c6:
+        label: "6"
+        concurrency: 6
+        args:
+          - "--max-num-seqs"
+          - "6"
+          - "--kv-cache-memory-bytes"
+          - "53687091200"
+          - "--compilation-config"
+          - '{"cudagraph_mode":"FULL_AND_PIECEWISE","cudagraph_capture_sizes":[7,14,21,28,35,42,100,200,300,400,500]}'
+        env:
+          VLLM_DSV4_MEGA_FP8_COMBINE: "1"
+      c10:
+        label: "10"
+        concurrency: 10
+        image: "vllm/vllm-openai@sha256:d428631bb917a33d22308265d1b8be91522f862bf9fd133bee62dde3313664ae"
+        args:
+          - "--max-num-seqs"
+          - "10"
+          - "--kv-cache-memory-bytes"
+          - "53687091200"
+          - "--compilation-config"
+          - '{"cudagraph_mode":"FULL_AND_PIECEWISE","cudagraph_capture_sizes":[7,14,21,28,35,42,49,56,63,70,100,200,300,400,500]}'
+          - "--prefix-cache-retention-interval"
+          - "32768"
+          - "--prefill-schedule-interval"
+          - "64"
+        json_args:
+          "--attention-config": { indexer_tp_shard_min_rows: 4096 }
+      c14:
+        label: "14"
+        concurrency: 14
+        args:
+          - "--max-num-seqs"
+          - "14"
+          - "--kv-cache-memory-bytes"
+          - "53687091200"
+          - "--compilation-config"
+          - '{"cudagraph_mode":"FULL_AND_PIECEWISE","cudagraph_capture_sizes":[7,14,21,28,35,42,49,56,63,70,77,84,91,98,100,200,300,400,500]}'
+        env:
+          VLLM_DSV4_MEGA_FP8_COMBINE: "1"
+    runbook: |
+      The TP8 points of the B200 AgentX lane (`dsv4-fp4-b200-vllm-agentic-mtp` and its low-concurrency
+      companion, [SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX#4554](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4554)) serve the
+      0813 checkpoint with DSpark (six draft tokens) as one aggregated vLLM worker on one 8-GPU B200 node: TP8, no
+      expert parallelism, no host KV offload. Each GPU holds a fixed 50 GiB KV cache and `--max-num-seqs` equals the
+      concurrency.
+
+      Concurrency 4 is the low-latency variant: a 40 GiB KV cache, the `deep_select` sparse indexer top-k backend and
+      graph capture up to 16384 tokens. Concurrency 10 sets `--prefix-cache-retention-interval 32768` and
+      `--prefill-schedule-interval 64`, shards the indexer at 4096 rows (`indexer_tp_shard_min_rows`) and leaves
+      `VLLM_DSV4_MEGA_FP8_COMBINE` unset. Concurrency 4 and 10 were measured on a second pinned image, shown on
+      those points.
+
+      Left out of the command: the lane also exported `VLLM_PREFIX_CACHE_RETENTION_INTERVAL`, which vLLM removed in
+      v0.30.0 ([vllm#55353](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/55353)) in favour of the flag above, so it had
+      no effect on the image it ran on; and `--served-model-name`, which the builder replaces with the checkpoint ID.
+      The throughput points in InferenceX swap block verification for synthetic rejection at a committed
+      acceptance length so every point is measured at the same acceptance rate; the command does not set it.

+    label: "AgentX DEP"

+      InferenceX swap block verification for synthetic rejection at a committed acceptance length so every point is
+      measured at the same acceptance rate; the command does not set it.
